'''Silvana Santos''' (born December 14, 1959, Sao Paulo, Brazil), is a Brazilian geneticist and biologist known for her research into rare developmental disorders related to [[inbreeding]]. She led the research group that discovered [[SPOAN syndrome]] in [[Serrinha dos Pintos]], a [[Municipalities of Brazil|municipality]] with a highly inbred population in the state of [[Rio Grande do Norte]] in the [[Northeast Region, Brazil|Northeast region]] of [[Brazil]].<ref>{{Cite web |title="Everyone Is A Cousin" In This Village. Courtesy: A Rare Genetic Condition |url=https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/everyone-is-a-cousin-in-this-village-courtesy-a-rare-genetic-condition-8392556 |access-date=2025-05-12 |website=NDTV |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last1=Granchi |first1=Giulia |last2=Tavares |first2=Vitor |date=2025-05-11 |title=The rare disease in a remote town where 'almost everyone is a cousin' |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ce80d4yppl3o |access-date=2025-05-12 |website=BBC News |language=en-GB}}</ref>

She has also discovered another novel developmental syndrome involving the development of the limbs, first observed in the municipality of [[Riacho de Santana, Rio Grande do Norte|Riacho de Santana]], also in Rio Grande do Norte.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Pivetta |first=Marcos |date=January 2009 |title=A recently discovered syndrome |url=https://revistapesquisa.fapesp.br/en/a-recently-discovered-syndrome/ |access-date=2025-05-12 |website=revistapesquisa.fapesp.br |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Santos |first1=Silvana C. |last2=Pardono |first2=Eliete |last3=Ferreira da Costa |first3=Maria Ione |last4=de Melo |first4=Aurea Nogueira |last5=Graciani |first5=Zodja |last6=de Albuquerque e Souza |first6=Alessandra Cavalcanti |last7=Lezirovitz |first7=Karina |last8=Thiele-Aguiar |first8=Renata Soares |last9=Mingroni-Netto |first9=Regina Célia |last10=Opitz |first10=John M. |last11=Kok |first11=Fernando |last12=Otto |first12=Paulo A. |date=2008-12-15 |title=A previously undescribed syndrome combining fibular agenesis/hypoplasia, oligodactylous clubfeet, anonychia/ungual hypoplasia, and other defects |journal=American Journal of Medical Genetics. Part A |volume=146A |issue=24 |pages=3126–3131 |doi=10.1002/ajmg.a.32580 |issn=1552-4833 |pmid=19012338}}</ref> The syndrome received her surname ''Santos'' and it is caused by a mutation in [[WNT7A]] gene.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Alves |first1=Leandro U |last2=Santos |first2=Silvana |last3=Musso |first3=Camila M |last4=Ezquina |first4=Suzana AM |last5=Opitz |first5=John M |last6=Kok |first6=Fernando |last7=Otto |first7=Paulo A |last8=Mingroni-Netto |first8=Regina C |title=Santos syndrome is caused by mutation in the WNT7A gene |journal=Journal of Human Genetics |date=December 2017 |volume=62 |issue=12 |pages=1073–1078 |doi=10.1038/jhg.2017.86|pmid=28855715 }}</ref>

She has worked as a professor at the [[State University of Paraíba]] since 2008.<ref>{{Cite web |title=A bióloga brasileira que descobriu uma doença rara e influencia o mundo |url=https://saude.abril.com.br/medicina/a-biologa-brasileira-que-descobriu-uma-doenca-rara-e-influencia-o-mundo |access-date=2025-05-12 |website=Veja Saúde |language=pt-BR}}</ref>

In 2024, she was recognised by the BBC in their [[100 Women (BBC)|annual list of 100 inspiring and influential women]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=3 December 2024 |title=BBC 100 Women 2024: Who is on the list this year? |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/resources/idt-4f79d09b-655a-42f8-82b4-9b2ecebab611 |access-date=2025-05-12 |website=BBC News |language=en-GB}}</ref>
